stop_rule: New captured-site execution was admitted only if every frozen benchmark and causal gate passed; the powered causal gates failed.
adjudication: The captured scene was ingested and executed historically, but the frozen benchmark WAM/evaluator was not portable to it, no useful total policy ordering was produced, and abstention correctness was not independently calibrated. This fails the captured-site transfer component without making a site-specific physical claim.
proves: historical captured-3DGS ingestion, simulator execution, and abstention under a different stack
does_not_prove: frozen-stack transfer, useful policy ordering, abstention correctness, site-specific physical accuracy, or physical success
